title: Positioning and Float
description: Understand how to position elements precisely using CSS position properties and manage layouts with float and clear techniques.

lessons.title: Static Positioning (default)
lessons.content: All elements are positioned statically by default, flowing naturally in the document layout.

lessons.title: Absolute Positioning
Positioning Pitfalls and Best Practices
lessons.content: Avoid overusing absolute positioning for layouts. Use relative or sticky for smoother, responsive designs. Always test across screen sizes.
